name: Cable Crossover
steps: Hold a handle from each high pulley and stand between the towers in a stable split stance.
Lean slightly forward with elbows softly bent.
Bring hands down and together in front of the chest.
Open the arms under control without forcing the shoulders far behind the torso.
cues: Keep the torso still as the arms sweep.
mistakes: Turning the fly into a press.
Reaching too far backward under tension.
breathing: Exhale as the hands come together; inhale as the arms open.
